name: Note School: Piano Reading
subtitle: Treble & bass for kids
promotionalText: Play the note on your piano. Note School listens and gives feedback. Help your child build a daily practice habit with 20 free notes, helpful hints, and celebrations.
description:
Help your child connect notes on the staff with keys on a real piano. (Formerly Musica.) Note School shows a note, listens as they play, and gives feedback with helpful hints and celebrations.

Use an acoustic piano or a digital piano with its speakers on. Note School listens through your iPhone microphone; no MIDI cable is needed. Practice individual notes in short sessions between lessons.

START WITH 20 FREE NOTES A DAY
• One learner profile and treble-clef practice
• A daily goal your child can complete
• Beginner settings and adjustable practice notes
• Note-name and keyboard hints when they need help
• Celebrations for correct answers and completed goals

GROW WITH NOTE SCHOOL PREMIUM
• Unlimited daily practice
• Profiles for more children
• Bass clef and the full grand staff
• A progress calendar with daily scores and stars
• A record of the notes practiced each day

MADE FOR FAMILY PRACTICE
Choose a goal and note range that suit your child. Place your iPhone near the piano, enable the microphone, and let them practice at their own pace. Note School supports individual-note reading practice alongside piano lessons; it is not a song course or a touchscreen piano.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads. No accounts. No data collection. Profiles and practice history stay on your device. Microphone audio is processed on-device and is not recorded or transmitted. Purchase screens are behind a parental gate.

Note School Premium is an optional auto-renewing monthly or yearly subscription, with a 7-day free trial for eligible subscribers. The price and trial eligibility are shown before purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account subscription settings. Family Sharing is supported for eligible subscriptions.

A sounding piano and microphone access are required for practice. You can keep using the free allowance without starting a subscription.

whatsNew:
Musica is now Note School: same app, new name and a fresh icon.

• A new name and icon that say what it does: reading notes on a real piano.
• You'll be asked for a rating after your first completed daily goal (no more than Apple allows).
• Your profiles, progress, and subscription carry over unchanged.
reviewNotes:
Version 1.2 renames the app from "Musica" to "Note School" (App Store name "Note School: Piano Reading") with a new icon and updated screenshots. Functionality is unchanged apart from the rating request now appearing after the first completed daily goal. The free allowance is 20 correct notes per day. Create a profile and open Practice; after 20 correct notes the daily-goal celebration appears. Reopening Practice after using the allowance shows the free-limit screen and a parental-gated Premium entry point. The Progress tab and adding a second profile also lead to the parental gate and subscription screen.

An acoustic piano or a digital piano with speakers is required. A separate device playing piano sounds near the iPhone microphone can be used for review. The microphone performs on-device note detection only; audio is not recorded or transmitted.

No sign-in is required. Existing monthly and yearly subscription products and prices are unchanged.
